Changes in 1.1.0

  • A clearer introduction, familiar business vocabulary and reader journeys.
  • A visual operating model, first-case preparation and explicit access decisions.
  • Worked examples for municipalities and professional councils.
  • Reference implementation choices, AI/privacy guidance and editable resources.
  • English, Brazilian Portuguese, European Portuguese and Spanish.

Version 1 baseline

On 21 October 2026, the existing website and accepted knowledge were recorded as v1.0.0 in their own repositories. The tagged files retain their historical 0.1 labels. This designation preserves history; it does not certify the model or announce a new product.
